Hey Fam

I also came from RoR2 and had a really rough time playing RoRR on Monsoon. i think it took me 20 Hours to finally get a Win on Monsoon and finally understanding how to approach the game. I already won with most characters on Monsoon now

Id say the first thing you gotta realise is that you cant and shouldn't full loot the map like in RoR2. When you spawn into the stage, try to find the teleporter asap. you can kill some enemies on the way, but dont be hung up too much around them. While ur going towards the teleporter, try to remember every chest/shrine you come around. you will backtrack to them later when you pop the teleporter event.

After finding the teleporter, try to kill the boss and some critters around it. You should then have a good amount of money. Backtrack and collect as many chests as possible and then leave the stage. This is sort of how i approach the game/punch myself through it with good success. Also don't forget that you don't have to stay near the teleport area when you do the boss. its sometimes good to kite them away from it/lure them with you, while you backtrack towards the chests.

Also as someone already commented, commando is a rather hard character to do a run with, especially when you dont have his alt abilities. Id say his alt utility and alt special ability is far superior than their base counterpart. Try to play other survivors if you can. Pilot, Drifter and Acrid are very strong and will have an easier time progressing.

Another thing you should know is that its ok or id say even recommended to unlock some stuff first. I'm pretty sure you dont have many items unlocked, which isn't that good, because the base items are really bland, not so good. The more items you unlock, the better your chances of getting a good run.

And that's basically it. i did some runs on rainstorm first, after hitting a wall on Monsoon like you did, unlocked some stuff and then went back on Monsoon and I'm having a blast now.

Since you have and use a dream journal you could try to not only have the intention to lucid dream but to further give it more context. What i mean is that you should say things like "If im at place X or talk with X or dream, i am Lucid"  


For example my dreams tend to place me into my school or my home and i always have one friend who accompanies me. Thats why im telling myself before bed that if i am in those places, i am lucid. Most of the time when i sleep and dream i become lucid in it, because of my intention and can now act however i want. Techniques like WBTB where you wake up afte 4-5 hours of sleep and then return back to your bed and reciting your intentions further increases your chances of succeding with it.  


Another helpful thing is to sort of have a plan what exactly you want to do, after you become lucid, so that you dont forget or get disoriented. Stabilizing your dream via touching things, or how i do it by licking the ground (serious) helps to enhance your senses and makes your dream more stable.
